taṇhājāla.p: [Taṇhā+jāla] (pu,na) CL=7 It is lace net which is craving, Craving which is like lace net, Craving net or Craving network.

taṇhājātika.p: [Taṇhā+jāti+ka] (ti) CL=7 (Upādāna etc.,) which is cause of happening craving. (Upādāna means acquiring; appropriating; taking possession; grasping; clinging; identifying).
